Polished Agate Geode Pair
Natural Agate and Quartz Crystal

This matched pair of agate geode halves features a beautiful translucent grey and blue banding surrounding a crystalline quartz center. Each piece has been cut and polished on the face to reveal the intricate internal structures and mineral layers formed over millions of years. The exteriors retain their natural, rugged host rock texture, providing a striking contrast to the smooth, glossy polished interiors, making them ideal for modern home decor or mineral collections.
Matched set suitable for display as decorative bookends or shelf specimens
Translucent agate bands with subtle mineral inclusions and druzy crystal pockets
High-gloss polished finish on the display faces highlighting natural color variations
Natural stone weight provides stability for use as small bookends
